  "memo":"R08 holds because three accounts share the shipping address. The household exception does not apply: although shipping is to the account's home, its registration is too recent. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule condition holds, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Under §6.6(b), Linkage requires id_check, which has passed. All required checks are therefore complete, making clear mandatory under §5.3(a); no further check is needed. A legitimate new household member is more plausible than coordinated identity fraud following successful verification. No installments were due, so non-payment cannot support an adverse recommendation. This memo is advisory and sets no queue priority."
